licence.name: GPL-3.0-only
licence.source: The repository LICENSE is the GPLv3 text and the list header points to it, with no "or later", so CPAB treats the list as GPL-3.0-only. The same text ships as LICENSE at the top of the package.

checks.licenceStated: The list header "License:" points to https://github.com/hagezi/dns-blocklists/blob/main/LICENSE. That file was read on 2026-11-07: it is the GPLv3 text, byte-identical to CPAB's own LICENSE.
checks.licenceAccepted: GPL-3.0 is on the accepted set, only or later.
checks.notRefused: No NonCommercial or NoDerivatives term, nothing forbids redistribution or restricts the audience.

checks.aggregated: An aggregate. Its inputs are listed in sources.md at commit acded31b209c342f06c38af538281c7ed306202e, whose line 5 says "None of them is copied over one to one". Inputs checked on 2026-11-07, on the accepted set: TweetFeed CC0, validin-phish-feed MIT, KADhosts/FiltersHeroes CC BY-SA 4.0, ShadowWhisperer Unlicense, hostsVN MIT, chainapsis Apache-2.0, iam-py-test CC0, uAssets GPL-3.0, LanikSJ MIT, spmedia MIT, durablenapkin MIT, antispam-it GPL-3.0, matomo public domain, netapi CC BY 4.0. Not on the set or unknown: DNSBunker/CTI GPL-2.0-only, MetaMask eth-phishing-detect ("Don't be a dick" licence), DandelionSprout adfilt (Dandelicence), Phishing-Database/phishing, cbuijs/ut1, xRuffKez DNSBunker_DNSBL, siberguvenlik.gov.tr, kushari.org, hole.cert.pl. It passes only on HaGeZi's own-work statement, as HaGeZi Multi Light does (PRD D21). Care: read sources.md again at each snapshot, and go back to the advisor if OpenPhish, PhishTank or URLhaus appears in it.
checks.ownFile: The converted rules are one file of their own, never merged with another list, under GPL-3.0-only. The GPLv3 text is in the package as LICENSE.
checks.retrievable: A stable repository. The snapshot is fetched at the last commit that changed adblock/tif.mini.txt and records that commit, the list's own Version line and its SHA-256.
